title: Procedural Edge Jump On Node Drag
description: When moving procedural flow components (brep, vector, etc.) in the canvas, edges suddenly jump from input to output ports during drag due to proximity preview flipping between handle pairs.
summary: Fixed procedural flow edges visually jumping between input and output ports while dragging wired components (brep, vector, etc.). Node-drag proximity preview now ignores handles on the dragged node that already participate in committed edges, so the preview no longer flips between the closest input/output pair as the node moves. Also stopped retargeting hover to the proximity target during drag, which caused channel highlight to jump. Added regression test `node_drag_proximity_skips_wired_handles_on_dragged_node`.
